text:
hana: Quick check — SOC2 control C-LOG-3 needs an owner for evidence sampling and scheduled ingest. Auditor asked for sampled artifacts (run logs + manifests) in ~2 weeks. @tyler @priya any takers?

tyler: I can own the ingestion pipeline (kafka -> s3 -> audit-lake) but need product to confirm event schema and retention. what's our retention target? :thinking: 

priya: infra can own S3 lifecycle and the ETL runner. I'll spin up a run schedule in infra-schedules and add a job that writes a manifest. Need list of sources & target retention in days.

matt: product here — we have app-events (v2) and auth-events; retention default is 365d but compliance might want 7 years? I'll check with legal. PR referenced: https://git.internal/repo/pulls/789

hana: ideally 365 is fine for now; auditor specifically needs proof we can produce sampled evidence + immutable manifests. Also need to show we ran an acceptance test. Can we have a test run that outputs sha256 of each object and a signed manifest? Example script:

`````
sha256sum *.ndjson > manifest.sha256
gpg --detach-sign --armor manifest.sha256
`````

priya: we can add a post-run step that signs manifest with infra-key. KMS/HSM question — do we sign with customer HSM or our internal key? @matt any constraint?

tyler: our pipeline already supports KMS-encrypt-at-rest. For signing we need HSM integration. sec-eng, do we have a policy? @hana

hana: Security preference is HSM-backed signing for audit evidence. We have an HSM slot reserved for compliance. I'll get key provisioning started; need owner to request access. :white_check_mark:

matt: I'll open a product ticket to approve schema and request key access. I'll add acceptance criteria: sample manifest, signed artifact, proof of retention lifecycle rule, and a run log with UUID + timestamps.

audit-bot: reminder: evidence upload window opens 2025-05-10. Please mark items as 'evidence-ready' in the control tracker.

priya: created infra-ticket INFRA-3421 and scheduled a nightly test ingest for next Tue. Added steps to sign manifest (uses /keys/compliance/hsm-sign). :rocket:

tyler: I'll add a quick smoke test in the pipeline that validates md5/sha sums and uploads a run log to /audit/ingest-runs/2912345678.json

hana: awesome. Owners: pipeline=tyler, infra=priya, product=matt, security=hana. Next check-in Friday EOD. If anyone needs me to escalate key provisioning, ping.

matt: noted. I'll link the PRs and add reviewers: @priya @tyler. :+1:

tyler: quick question — who will be reviewer for the run logs evidence? I'd like one sec-eng reviewer plus product.

hana: I'll review security aspects, matt cover schema. We'll post evidence links in the control tracker when ready. :eyes:

priya: FYI tagging the HSM team: @hsm-oncall — please approve signing key grant for infra-runner INFRA-3421.

hsm-oncall: ack, will review by EOD tomorrow. Please include key usage policy and intended expiry.

hana: thanks all. Closing loop for now — I'll follow up with an explicit checklist on the control tracker. :calendar:
